entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales' or 'Support' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to a VeloFit support agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I need to return my VeloBand. Order number is 774-B-901.
Okay, I have your order pulled up. Just to understand the situation, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
Look, it doesn't matter. I tried to do this weeks ago and your website was broken. I just need the return label you were supposed to give me then.
I understand your frustration. Can you tell me the date you attempted the return online? I can check for any logged system issues.

It was January 4th. Your whole site had a massive website error. The page just timed out and I couldn't print anything. I even took a screenshot because I knew this would happen. Your system was down, not my problem.

Thank you for that information. Let me just check the records for that date... and yes, I do see a note about a major service outage that day. I appreciate you bringing that to my attention. Let me just review the return eligibility for your order.
Just tell me yes or no.
Yes. I see you received the item 35 days ago, and our policy allows for returns within 10 days. You're unfortunately outside the timeframe, so I can go ahead and process that for you now.

Absolutely. I've just authorized the return in our system. You'll be receiving an email with the prepaid shipping label within the next five minutes. Just print that out and attach it to the original packaging.
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
